06 · Good to know

Trip FAQ

Quick answers about the Bhubaneswar to Visakhapatnam trip.

What is Vizag Express?

Vizag Express is a train trip by 7 friends from Bhubaneswar, Odisha to Visakhapatnam (Vizag), Andhra Pradesh. This site has the crew, the route, the places we plan to visit and the fun list for the journey.

How far is Visakhapatnam from Bhubaneswar by train?

About 440 km by rail along the East Coast line. Express trains take roughly 7 hours, depending on the train.

Which major stations are on the Bhubaneswar to Visakhapatnam route?

The line runs through Bhubaneswar (BBSR), Khurda Road (KUR), Brahmapur (BAM), Palasa (PSA), Srikakulam Rd (CHE), Vizianagaram (VZM) and Visakhapatnam (VSKP), passing Chilika Lake on the way.

When is the Vizag Express trip?

The date and train will be announced once tickets are booked. The boarding pass on this site then shows a live countdown.

Which places will the crew visit in Visakhapatnam?

Day 1: Simhachalam Temple (main stop), Ross Hill Church, Rama Krishna Beach and INS Kursura Submarine Museum. Day 2: Kailasagiri (main stop), Tenneti Park, Indira Gandhi Zoological Park and Rushikonda Beach (main stop).

What is Simhachalam Temple?

A 13th-century hilltop temple to Varaha Narasimha, 300 m up the Simhachalam hills. Sri Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple stands on the Simhachalam Hill Range, about 300 metres above sea level on the edge of Visakhapatnam. It is dedicated to Lord Vishnu in his Varaha Narasimha form; legend says he appeared here as the lion-headed protector of his devotee Prahlada.

What is Kailasagiri?

A 173 m hilltop park with a ropeway, a glass skybridge and sweeping sea views. Kailasagiri is a hilltop park developed by VMRDA across about 380 acres of native trees and gardens. The hill rises to 173 metres and looks out over the whole city, Beach Road and the long curve of the Bay of Bengal.

What is Rushikonda Beach?

A golden, Blue Flag-certified beach north of the city, loved for clean sand and water sports. Rushikonda Beach lies north of the city along the coast road, where green hills roll down to a wide curve of golden sand. It is maintained by the Andhra Pradesh Tourism Development Corporation (APTDC).

Who is travelling on Vizag Express?

The crew is Durga Dutta Pandia, Manash R. Mahanand, Ashish Mahanta, Amit Ku. Pradhan, Akash Das, Somesh Ku. Nayak and Sandeep Padua.

Who handles what on the trip?

Ticket / Train: Amit, Somesh and Ashish (Notification & Update). Place / Destination: Amit, Akash, Somesh and Sandeep. Budget / Planning: Ashish, Akash, Durga and Manash. Payment / Investments: Ashish and Durga. Event / Activity: Amit, Somesh, Manash and Sandeep.

What will the crew do during the journey?

Playing Cards (Ranga, Gadha, Natish), UNO, Reels (Insta, Vlog) and Photography.
